end.summary:
Siya described health as physical, mental and social well-being, not only absence of illness.
They linked sleep, breakfast, fruit, activity, screen use and relationships to health.
They explained that sharing worries can support mental health.
They gave examples: football can support physical and social health; talking to mother can support mental health.
Teach-back was not yet passed.
end.parentNote: Today Siya practised connecting daily habits with physical, mental and social health. They used examples and explained their thinking, especially how sleep, food, activity and talking to someone can affect well-being. No clear mix-up was seen, but the final three-part explanation still needs another practice round. At home, ask Siya to sort five daily habits into physical, mental or social health and explain one choice.
